## Purpose
"Dynamic MCP Tool Server — Analysis & Developer Guide": an analysis of a separate, Railway-hosted dynamic MCP tool factory. Python code is POSTed to it; it detects dependencies (with Codestral), installs them, registers the code as an MCP tool, and exposes it over HTTP REST, SSE and Streamable HTTP.

## Accuracy
- **It describes an external service,** not code in this repository.
- **It includes a live URL on railway.app,** whose current state is unknown.
- **It is the kind of server** the remote-servers `mcp_code_endpoint` provider (`/submit-code`) targets.

## Used by
Developers integrating the external MCP tool server.

Optional background. Not needed to rebuild this platform.
